description: This file defines functions and types for handling D-Bus type signatures, including signature parsing, validation, and type mapping, within the 'github.com/godbus/dbus/v5' package.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a D-Bus type signature string.

methods.name: SignatureOf
methods.description: Concatenates signatures of provided values into a Signature.

methods.name: SignatureOfType
methods.description: Returns the signature of a specific type.

methods.name: ParseSignature
methods.description: Parses a string into a Signature, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: ParseSignatureMust
methods.description: Parses a string into a Signature, panicking on error.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the Signature is empty.

methods.name: Single
methods.description: Checks if the Signature represents a single complete type.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Signature.
